issues.explanation: No CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] despite conventions requiring it.
database-schema modeling note still says priority levels are configurable presets per entity, contradicting backend-owned TotemPriorities with no per-entity custom priorities.
Pairing 10/min throttle has a 429 test but ticket 30/min throttle has no test.
services.totem.web_origin duplicates TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN already read directly by config/cors.php and is never used.

conventions.evidence: docs/api/totem.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/database-schema.md updated; migration has reversible down(): database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_totem_tables.php:1015-1020; audit via Log::channel('audit'): app/Console/Commands/TotemPairingCode.php:69, app/Http/Controllers/Totem/TotemAuthController.php:150-163; reuses App\Actions\IssueTicket with TicketChannel::Totem: app/Http/Controllers/Totem/TotemController.php:284; missing CHANGELOG.md entry; stale configurable-presets note in database-schema

readability.evidence: TotemAuth::resolve, TotemController::context/resolveQueue small focused helpers with clear names; consistent Laravel style; no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: pairing command random_int zero-padded +10min +audit: app/Console/Commands/TotemPairingCode.php:59-72; auth 400/401 + transaction + lockForUpdate + JWT + entity pair: app/Http/Controllers/Totem/TotemAuthController.php:105-173; totem.auth intersection scope + last_seen_at saveQuietly: app/Http/Middleware/TotemAuth.php:395-462; queues/priorities/ticket + 403/404/422/201 + IssueTicket channel totem: app/Http/Controllers/Totem/TotemController.php:206-300; CORS localhost/127.0.0.1 + TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN: config/cors.php:857-871; JWT HS256 claims iat/exp/jti: app/Totem/TotemJwt.php:635-692; priorities 0/10/20 single source: app/Totem/TotemPriorities.php:734-750

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves task.md (models, migration, factories, JWT, middleware, controllers, routes, CORS, config, docs, tests); no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: Same 401 no oracle: app/Http/Controllers/Totem/TotemAuthController.php:115-155; hash_equals + alg HS256 check + exp check: app/Totem/TotemJwt.php:668-689; middleware 401 on missing/invalid/expired/inactive/mismatch: app/Http/Middleware/TotemAuth.php:435-450; entity slug check 403 + queue within-entity 404 + scope 403: app/Http/Controllers/Totem/TotemController.php:311-345; is_int + isValid priority + InactiveQueueException: app/Http/Controllers/Totem/TotemController.php:279-287; audit never logs full code (suffix only)

simplicity.evidence: Reuses IssueTicket instead of duplicating rules; minimal correct HS256 allowed by task instead of new dependency: app/Totem/TotemJwt.php; single-source TotemPriorities shared by endpoint and validation; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php covers pairing command, 400 format, 401 oracle cases, pairing success+replay, unauthenticated/invalid/expired/inactive/mismatch, last_seen_at refresh, queue ordering + immediate detach effect, 403/404 matrix, priorities exact JSON, ticket issuance A001/A002 channel totem, CORS allow/deny + extra origin, pairing 429; missing ticket 30/min 429 test

review.summary: Implements the full totem BFF pairing + JWT + queues/priorities/ticket contract with correct error codes, scope intersection, throttles, CORS and docs. Missing only a CHANGELOG entry, one stale docs line, and a ticket-throttle test, so approve with nits.
